cases.name: exact_git_pin
cases.expect: upstream/DesktopCommanderMCP is exactly the declared commit

cases.name: locked_install
cases.expect: npm ci --ignore-scripts succeeds against the pinned package-lock

cases.name: upstream_build_linux
cases.expect: exact upstream source builds on Linux

cases.name: upstream_build_windows
cases.expect: exact upstream source builds on Windows

cases.name: live_tools_list
cases.expect: built upstream MCP server initializes and returns tools/list

cases.name: command_string_schema
cases.expect: start_process requires a command string argument

cases.name: arbitrary_command_execution
cases.expect: a real command string executes through upstream start_process and returns a unique marker

cases.name: veramesh_entrypoint_hash_binding
cases.expect: VeraMesh verifies both packaged node.exe and upstream dist/index.js hashes

cases.name: veramesh_exact_command
cases.expect: VeraMesh builds node + entrypoint + --no-onboarding without rewriting Desktop Commander tool semantics

cases.name: entrypoint_tamper_rejected
cases.expect: VeraMesh refuses a changed Desktop Commander entrypoint

cases.name: argument_injection_rejected
cases.expect: VeraMesh command construction rejects control/newline/single-quote injection into its launcher arguments

cases.name: relay_transparency
cases.expect: if VeraRelay is selected, tool names/arguments/results survive transit without semantic filtering
